title: Woody Open-Scale Conifer Cone
description: One original whole stylised woody conifer seed cone: a small grounded tapered central spindle supports six staggered height zones of complete thick folded woody shield scales, producing a broad lower-middle body and a narrow closed-looking tip. Every scale has finite faces and an embedded root on the whole spindle, not a texture card or floating plate. All spindle sections, scale sweeps, tier profile and individual bearings are newly authored. Not a needle crown removed from an old conifer, a sunflower with more petals or a lotus cup head recoloured. One natural prop, zero scenes; scales and seeds are not counted as assets. Three opaque matte woody PBR roles, no textures. Metres, Z up, true whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Static stylised plant form only: no exact species, scale count biology, seed-release mechanism, moisture-driven motion, growth, ecology, physical stability or real-world use claim.
